traces.limitation: Inclusive wrapper timings and 500ms state sampling add overhead. Bone visits are estimated from dirty full-skeleton rebuilds, not a per-bone instrumentation count.

cacheAB.limitation: Paused real demo; cached pickup-template animation groups only. Instrumented diagnostic, not a gameplay FPS benchmark.

batchedPose.limitation: Positive uniform mesh scale, parent-first synthetic binary rig. No negative/nonuniform scale, Vanguard bind conventions, root position transfer, live physics or visual parity claim.

prestep.limitation: Small synthetic jointed ragdoll with floor, not Vanguard asset parity or a performance benchmark. Quaternion component differences are sign-sensitive, not orientation error.

linkedPrepare.limitation: One static linked bone. Detaching links is a diagnostic control, not a proposed game change. Does not quantify current Vanguard pose-LOD uploads.
